footer.admin: You received this email because an administrator of your Canopy instance sent it.
footer.account: You received this email because of activity on your Canopy account. If this was not you, contact your administrator.
footer.dropOff: You received this email because this address was given on a Canopy upload page.

test.subject: Canopy test email
test.title: Email is working
test.body: This test confirms that Canopy can send emails with the current settings.

invitation.subject: You are invited to Canopy
invitation.title: Welcome, {name}
invitation.preheader: Choose your password to start using Canopy.
invitation.body: An administrator created a Canopy account for you. Choose a password to sign in.
invitation.expiry: This link works once and expires in 7 days.

reset.subject: Reset your Canopy password
reset.title: Password reset for {name}
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your Canopy account. Choose a new one with the button below.
reset.expiry: This link works once and expires in 1 hour.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

security.notYou: If this was not you, change your password and contact your administrator.

password_changed.subject: Your Canopy password changed
password_changed.title: Password changed, {name}
password_changed.body: The password of your Canopy account was just changed and your other sessions were signed out.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on
two_factor_enabled.title: Two-factor turned on, {name}
two_factor_enabled.body: Signing in to your Canopy account now also asks for a code from your authenticator app.

two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off
two_factor_disabled.title: Two-factor turned off, {name}
two_factor_disabled.body: Signing in to your Canopy account no longer asks for an authenticator code.

new_sign_in.subject: New sign-in to Canopy
new_sign_in.title: New sign-in, {name}
new_sign_in.body: Your Canopy account was just used to sign in from a device or address it had not used recently.

dropOffCode.subject: Your code to send files: {code}
dropOffCode.title: Your code: {code}
dropOffCode.preheader: Type it on the upload page to send your files.
dropOffCode.body: You asked to send files through the link “{name}”. Type this code on the upload page to confirm your e-mail address.
dropOffCode.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: nothing is sent without the code.

dropOffReceived.subject: {who} sent {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to {link}
dropOffReceived.preheader: Files arrived through your upload link.
dropOffReceived.anonymous: The depositor did not say who they are.
dropOffReceived.footer: You receive this email because you asked to be told about drop-offs on this link. Turn it off by creating the link again without it.
